messages:
Maya: FYI — Sales just logged a request from AcmeCorp: wants a turnkey Terraform module to provision Redwood Private + SCIM provisioning for user sync and SSO integration. Ticket: https://zendesk.example/agent/tickets/2248
Raj: rough scope? infra only or also config for SCIM app + SSO metadata?
Priya: customer requires on-prem connector to SCIM API (no cloud-hosted provisioning), must pass SOC2 + EU data residency. Timeline: negotiating, but asks for Q3 pilot.
Luis: ACV looks decent (~$180k ARR if pilot turns prod). Sales pushing for early access.
Maya: ok — triage asks: 1) minimal deliverables 2) acceptance criteria 3) owner + estimate 4) backlog tags + priority
Sam: for devex, we'll need Python and JS examples + a marketplace listing (if they want easy install). Also want example policy for network/firewalls.
Raj: technical note — private deploy + SCIM will need a small connector service to translate our SCIM schema -> customer's LDAP. Depending on customer's auth, SAML/ODIC SSO mapping might be extra.
Maya: propose MVE: Terraform module (provisioning VMs / k8s resources for Redwood Private), a lightweight SCIM connector (container image + config), and sample docs + SDK snippets (Python + JS). Exclude advanced LDAP mapping for initial pilot.
Priya: acceptance criteria from customer POV: 1) deploys via terraform in their VPC w/ example vars 2) user sync of up to 5k users via SCIM in pilot 3) end-to-end SSO configured (SAML or OIDC) 4) audit logs sent to their SIEM
Raj: engineering notes: estimate 6 wks for module + infra templates, 4 wks for SCIM connector + 2 wks for docs/examples. Depends on security review and legal for data flow.
Maya: priority? Sales suggests P1 for pilot. Product leaning P2 with support for pilot customers only. Thoughts?
Luis: Sales votes P1 for pilot access. We'll fast-track if legal/security greenlights.
Sam: tagging suggestion for backlog: `integration:terraform`, `integration:scim`, `deployment:private`, `customer:acmecorp`, `priority:pilot` — also add `owner:eng-ml` or `owner:devex` later.
intake-bot: ticket created #INT-2248, assigned to product-triage. link: https://tracker.example/INT-2248 :eyes:
Maya: next steps — Raj to scope tech design doc w/ estimate, Sam to prepare example SDK snippets and marketplace checklist, Priya to pull compliance ask list from customer, Luis to keep sales aligned. Update this thread with links. I'll set status card in roadmap board.
Raj: will start doc today, ping me for env details.
Sam: will draft sample repo and a minimal `README` template.
Priya: I'll coordinate the required certifications and share via drive.
Maya: thanks everyone. tagging for next sync: @eng-platform @devex @legal. :thumbsup:
